newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to launch cheaper electric bicycles.
newsitem.headline: Honda to launch cheaper electric bicycles.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Monday it planned to launch a cheaper range of power-assisted electric bicycles than its existing series in light of growing competition in this product sector.

It said the new Racoon series will be launched in Japan on February 15 with prices starting at 79,500 yen. This compares with 126,000 to 136,000 yen for its existing models. The battery charger will cost 10,000 yen.

Industry competitor Yamaha Motor Co Ltd announced last month that it would start selling power-assisted bicycles in January next year priced at 87,800 yen. Yamaha had a sales target of 100,000 units for calendar 1997.
Honda hopes to sell 55,000 electric power-assisted bicycles in calendar 1997. Honda sold a total of 19,000 electric power-assisted bicycles in January to November.
